breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. For a counter-flow flame configuration, the two inlets must have opposing velocities. The specification correctly sets the fuel inlet (x=0) velocity to the +x direction, but it incorrectly sets the air inlet (x=0.02) velocity to the +x direction as well. The air inlet velocity should have been in the -x direction to oppose the fuel flow.
